list-intro: Every ad test round: the directions AI drafted, the sample images and the full-test results, newest first.
list-empty-description: New tests are set up in Marketing tests.
legacy-notice: This older test flow has been retired: its tests can be viewed but no longer changed, generated or imported into.
legacy-notice-link: Start new tests in Marketing tests
new-intro: Answer three questions, or start with the defaults. AI drafts a few creative directions; nothing is generated until you confirm.
new-product-not-ready: This product hasn't been confirmed and published yet. Go back to the product page and confirm the product card first.
new-quick-summary-no-audience: Defaults: {{goal}}, using the audience on the product card, {{scale}}.
q-goal-explore-hint: Start from the product card and draft a few different creative directions.
q-goal-optimize-hint: Start from assets that already passed review and vary them.
q-seeds-empty: This product has no approved assets yet. Explore new directions first, then come back to improve the good ones once they pass review.
q-seeds-required: Improving existing ads needs at least one asset.
q-audience-custom-placeholder: e.g. Commuters who just bought an EV and have their own parking spot
q-audience-none: The product card has no audience. Write one sentence, or leave it blank to use the product description.
q-audience-loading: Reading the audiences on the product card
q-scale-sample-hint: 1 image per direction, usually 3–5 in all, to check the directions first.
q-scale-small-hint: Up to {{combinations}} combinations, {{variants}} images each, {{images}} images at most.
q-scale-full-hint: Up to {{combinations}} combinations, {{variants}} images each, {{images}} images at most.
q-scale-note: Once the plan is drafted, each size shows its exact image count and maximum cost, and you confirm again before generating.
plan-not-found: This test plan wasn't found. It may belong to another workspace or have been deleted.
plan-drafting-body: This usually takes under a minute. You'll then see 3–5 directions, each saying what it tests.
plan-stalled: Nothing has changed for a long time.
plan-failed-title: No plan could be drafted this time
plan-failed-cost-hint: AI drafting calls that completed may be charged even though the plan failed; no images were generated. Drafting again makes new calls.
plan-failed-bind-key: Bind an OpenAI key to draft with the real model.
directions-intro: Each card is one idea to test. Delete the ones you don't want, reword them, or add an idea of your own; the image count and cost update as you go.
direction-factor-min: Keep at least one value for each factor
add-idea-field-title-placeholder: e.g. Scheduling a charge with one tap in a garage on a rainy night
add-idea-field-scene-placeholder: What is in the picture, where, and who is using it
totals-scale-hint: Make samples first to check the directions; expanding fills in the size chosen here (with “Samples first”, it expands to the full test).
totals-full-adds-nothing: Each direction has only 1 combination, so the full test would not test any new element. Edit a direction and pick one more value for a factor to widen the test.
totals-locked: The full test has been submitted, so the plan can no longer change. Start a new test round to try other directions.
action-expand-waiting: Samples are still generating; you can expand once they finish
action-expand-hint: Look at the samples, delete the directions you don't want, then expand.
confirm-sample-body: 1 combination per direction, {{images}} images in all.
confirm-expand-body: New combinations to generate: {{combinations}} · {{variants}} images each · {{images}} images in all.
confirm-expand-reused: The {{count}} combinations already generated as samples are reused and not charged again.
confirm-expand-reused_one: The {{count}} combination already generated as a sample is reused and not charged again.
confirm-cost: Maximum cost: {{cost}}, charged by actual usage.
confirm-free: Example mode: makes example images at no charge.
results-unmatched: {{count}} more images couldn't be matched to a direction; you can see them in Assets.
results-unmatched_one: {{count}} more image couldn't be matched to a direction; you can see it in Assets.
problem-revision_conflict: The plan was just changed elsewhere and has been refreshed. Please try again.
problem-precondition_required: The plan on this page was out of date and has been reloaded. Please try again.
problem-test_plan_locked: The full test has been submitted, so the plan can no longer change. Start a new test round to try other directions.
problem-test_plan_not_ready: The plan is still being drafted. Try again once drafting finishes.
problem-test_plan_run_in_progress: Generation is being submitted. Wait a moment and try again.
problem-sample_run_in_progress: Samples are still generating. Expand to the full test once they finish.
problem-nothing_to_generate: Every combination at this size has already been generated; there is nothing more to generate.
problem-credential_required: The generation defaults use OpenAI, but the workspace has no usable key yet.
problem-guardrail_exceeded: This generation would exceed the workspace's spending limit.
problem-spend_guardrail_exceeded: This generation would exceed the workspace's spending limit.
problem-mode_unavailable: The current execution mode is unavailable. Check the generation defaults.
problem-model_unavailable: The model in the generation defaults is unavailable. Check the generation defaults.
problem-entitlement_unavailable: Your current subscription doesn't include this generation feature.
problem-too_many_directions: There are too many directions. Delete some before adding more.
problem-direction_removed: This direction was deleted. Restore it before editing.
problem-direction_not_found: This direction is no longer in the plan. The page has been refreshed.
problem-product_not_published: Confirm the product card (publish the product) before setting up an ad test.
problem-product_archived: This product is archived and can't be tested any more.
problem-audience_card_out_of_range: The chosen audience is no longer on the product card. Choose again.
problem-seed_assets_required: Improving existing ads needs at least one asset.
problem-seed_asset_not_found: One of the chosen assets is no longer available. Choose again.
problem-legacy_test_plans_frozen: This older test flow has been retired and is view-only. Start new tests in Marketing tests.
problem-template_invalid: The test factors AI generated failed validation. Adjust the directions and try again.
problem-template_publish_failed: Something went wrong submitting the generation. Please try again.
problem-too_many_factor_values: This factor has too many values.
problem-direction_factor_missing: Keep at least one value for each factor.
problem-generation_defaults_owner_only: Only the Owner can change the generation defaults.
problem-provider_mode_mismatch: The execution mode and the model don't match.
problem-aspect_ratio_unsupported: This model doesn't support the chosen aspect ratio.
problem-variants_invalid: The images per combination exceed the model's limit.
problem-provider_unavailable: The chosen generation service is unavailable.
problem-unknown: That didn't go through. Please try again later.
problem-ask-owner: Ask the workspace Owner to handle this.
banner-mock: Example mode: generation makes example images without calling OpenAI and without charges.
banner-byok-missing: Generation defaults use OpenAI, but no usable key is bound yet, so generation requests will be refused.
banner-member-action: Ask the workspace Owner to bind an OpenAI key in Settings.
internal-intro: Raw identifiers and data for troubleshooting. They don't affect the plan.
take-no-ideas: This product has no ad ideas yet, so there are no ads to test.
take-no-kept: No ads are kept yet. Keep the ads you want to test on the ad ideas page first.
take-intro: Only now do you answer three questions. Everything else is filled in the usual way.
take-target-label: Up to what cost per order is it a success?
take-target-help: At or under this, the ad is worth more money.
take-budget-label: How much will this round spend?
take-budget-help: Your ad spend in Meta. It never goes through MarketAI.
take-landing-label: Which web address do the ads send people to?
take-landing-help: The product has no link of its own, so the ads need one.
take-defaults-summary: Everything else follows the usual defaults. Open to change any of them
take-default-audience-help-none: Left empty: the audience the AI read
take-attribution-7d_click_1d_view: Ordered within 7 days of a click or 1 day of a view
take-attribution-7d_click: Ordered within 7 days of a click
take-attribution-1d_click_1d_view: Ordered within 1 day of a click or a view
take-attribution-1d_click: Ordered within 1 day of a click
take-attribution-1d_view: Ordered within 1 day of a view
take-default-timezone-help: Your browser's to begin with. Use the time zone of your Meta ad account.
take-default-start-help: Left empty: tomorrow in the ad account's time zone.
take-default-currency-help: Use your Meta ad account's currency, so the report you send back matches.
take-default-rounds: Rounds in the whole test, at most
take-problem-money: Enter an amount above zero, with at most two decimals.
take-problem-days: Enter a whole number of days from 7 to 90.
take-problem-url: Enter a web address starting with http:// or https://.
take-problem-rounds: Enter a whole number from 1 to 20.
take-quote-idle: Answer the three questions, and this side tells you whether the money is enough for a verdict.
take-quote-stale: Working it out again for your new answers…
take-tier-enough-body: That is the fewest orders a verdict needs.
take-tier-direction-body: You can see which looks more promising, but it is not a verdict yet.
take-tier-rough-body: It can rule out what clearly fails, but can't tell good from bad.
take-orders-claim: Each claim gets about {{count}} orders, if each order costs exactly your target.
take-orders-claim_one: Each claim gets about {{count}} order, if each order costs exactly your target.
take-orders-expression: Each way of telling gets about {{count}} orders, if each order costs exactly your target.
take-orders-expression_one: Each way of telling gets about {{count}} order, if each order costs exactly your target.
take-orders-ad: This ad gets about {{count}} orders, if each order costs exactly your target.
take-orders-ad_one: This ad gets about {{count}} order, if each order costs exactly your target.
take-min: Each needs at least {{count}} orders for a verdict, so luck isn't read as a pattern.
take-min_one: Each needs at least {{count}} order for a verdict, so luck isn't read as a pattern.
take-needed: A verdict on all of them needs {{amount}} this round.
take-suggest: Or compare fewer: with {{count}} of them, each would get enough.
take-schedule: Runs {{count}} days, {{start}} to {{end}}, then waits {{lag}} days for orders to be credited to the ads.
take-schedule_one: Runs {{count}} day, {{start}} to {{end}}, then waits {{lag}} days for orders to be credited to the ads.
take-step-download-body: The images, copy and ad names are all in it.
take-step-meta-body: Spend {{amount}} this round. MarketAI never spends for you or changes your ads.
take-step-report-body: Export the report from Meta and upload it; the ad names tell which ad is which.
take-start-cost-note: At most this, on your API key, for {{count}} look-together checks. The plan, the round and the ad package cost nothing.
take-start-cost-note_one: At most this, on your API key, for 1 look-together check. The plan, the round and the ad package cost nothing.
take-start-uncertain: No answer came. Click again: it carries on with the same start and never opens a second test.
take-changed: The kept ads or the quote changed since you looked. Refresh and look again before starting.
take-unavailable-ads_not_exportable: {{count}} of the kept ads can't go into an ad package yet. Do the check before download first.
take-unavailable-ads_not_exportable_one: One of the kept ads can't go into an ad package yet. Do the check before download first.
take-progress-intro: The test starts once every check has its result and the ad package is made. You can leave this page; it carries on when you come back.
take-progress-package-waiting: Made once the checks are done
take-findings-title: Some checks didn't pass on these {{count}} ads
take-findings-title_one: Some checks didn't pass on this ad
take-findings-intro: Look at each one. If it is fine as it is, say why and carry on. To swap or take out an ad, cancel this test first.
take-check-belongs_to_intended_combinati: The ad shows the claim and the way of telling it should
take-check-expressions_distinct: It looks different from the same claim's other ways of telling
take-check-comparison_faithful: What changes and what stays the same match what this round compares
take-accept-label: Why is this ad fine as it is?
take-accept-help: Write one reason for each ad; it is kept with the test.
take-unproven-title: These ads have checks with nothing to show they passed
take-unproven-check_outdated: Its look-together check is out of date.
take-unproven-no_evidence: A check it needs has no result to stand on; check it on the ad ideas page.
take-unproven-help: Cancel this test, sort these ads out on the ad ideas page, then start again.
take-cancel: Cancel the test and change the ads
take-cancel-help: Nothing is in Meta yet. The round is kept as cancelled, and the kept ads can be tested again.
take-ready-next: Create the ads in Meta with the ad names in the package as they are, then send the report back.
take-package-failed: The ad package didn't get made.
take-open-run: Next: send the report back here
run-not-found: This test was not found in this workspace.
run-no-package-title: The ad package isn't ready yet
run-no-package-body: The checks and the ad package come first. Carry on where you took the ads to test.
run-summary: {{count}} ads · a success at {{target}} or less per order · {{budget}} this round · {{days}} days
run-summary_one: 1 ad · a success at {{target}} or less per order · {{budget}} this round · {{days}} days
run-step-run-body: Download the ad package and create the ads with its ad names.
run-step-run-done: Matched to the ads in Meta
run-step-report-body: The full report from the start to today, as often as you like.
run-step-report-done: Counted. Send a newer full report any time.
run-step-result-body: Once the round is over and its orders have come in.
run-step-result-due: The result can be read now.
run-changed-title: {{count}} ads were changed in the ad ideas after the test started
run-changed-title_one: This ad was changed in the ad ideas after the test started
run-changed-fact: A fact it cites was changed or removed.
run-changed-photo: A product photo it uses was rejected or can no longer be used.
run-changed-copy: Its words, claim or way of telling it were changed.
run-changed-advice: The ad in Meta still shows the old version: we suggest pausing it or making it again. This test carries on with what it started on, so its numbers and the ad package do not change.
run-no-answer: No answer came. Try again; it will not be done twice.
run-report-first: Once the ads are running, export the daily ad report in Meta from the day the test started to today, and upload it here. Nothing counts until you confirm it.
run-report-again: Each time, send the full report from the start to today. A newer report replaces the days it repeats; the earlier ones stay on record. If a report was wrong, export it again and send it.
run-report-account-help: The number shown in Meta Ads Manager, with or without act_.
run-report-account-invalid: Enter the account number: digits only, with or without act_ in front.
run-report-settings: This test was set up for {{currency}}, the {{timezone}} time zone, and orders counted as “{{attribution}}”. Export the report with the same settings.
run-report-settings-differ: My Meta account uses other settings
run-report-settings-help: Say what your report uses. If it is not what the test was set up for, the report cannot count, and the page says what differs.
run-report-issues: {{count}} problems to fix before it can count
run-report-issues_one: 1 problem to fix before it can count
run-report-settings-mismatch: This report cannot count as it is. {{settings}}
run-report-confirm-help-first: Once a report counts, the start date and the existing matches can no longer change; new Meta ads can still be matched.
run-report-confirm-help-again: It replaces the days and ads it repeats; the earlier report stays on record.
run-report-replaces: It replaced {{count}} rows of earlier reports.
run-report-replaces_one: It replaced 1 row of an earlier report.
run-report-excluded-other_ad: Meta ad {{id}}: {{count}} rows from {{first}} to {{last}} ({{spend}}). It is not one of this test's ads.
run-report-excluded-other_ad_one: Meta ad {{id}}: 1 row on {{first}} ({{spend}}). It is not one of this test's ads.
run-report-excluded-before_start: Meta ad {{id}}: {{count}} rows from {{first}} to {{last}} ({{spend}}), before the round started.
run-report-excluded-before_start_one: Meta ad {{id}}: 1 row on {{first}} ({{spend}}), before the round started.
run-report-excluded-after_end: Meta ad {{id}}: {{count}} rows from {{first}} to {{last}} ({{spend}}), after the round's last day.
run-report-excluded-after_end_one: Meta ad {{id}}: 1 row on {{first}} ({{spend}}), after the round's last day.
run-start-question: It looks like you started on {{day}}. Change the start to {{day}}?
run-start-question-help: The test was planned to start on {{day}}. The last day moves with the start and the number of days stays the same. This can change only before the first report counts.
run-bind-intro: The short keys in the Meta ad names filled these in. Check them, then confirm once; nothing is saved before that.
run-bind-no-names: The report has no ad name column, so choose the ad each Meta ad shows.
run-bind-open: {{count}} Meta ads need you to choose or skip.
run-bind-open_one: 1 Meta ad needs you to choose or skip.
run-bind-locked: A report already counts, so existing matches stay as they are; only new Meta ads can be matched.
run-bind-suggested-ma_key: Filled in from the package key in its name.
run-bind-suggested-mk_code: Filled in from the image code in its name.
run-bind-status-no_match: Its name has no key of this test. Choose the ad, or skip it if it is not part of the test.
run-bind-status-ambiguous: Its name fits more than one ad. Choose the right one.
run-bind-status-bound_elsewhere: This Meta ad is matched in another test. Usually skip it.
run-bind-skip: Skip: not part of this test
run-bind-none: Match at least one Meta ad, or the report counts nothing.
run-numbers-through: Counted reports run to {{day}}. These numbers will change; the result comes from {{result}}.
run-numbers-none: No report counts yet. The result comes from {{result}}.
run-numbers-short: {{count}} more orders needed for a verdict (at least {{min}}).
run-numbers-short_one: 1 more order needed for a verdict (at least {{min}}).
run-numbers-enough: Enough orders for a verdict (at least {{min}}).
run-numbers-deviated: Something ran differently from the plan: no conclusion on this group this round.
run-deviation-title: What ran differently from the plan
run-deviation-note-placeholder: For example the budget, the audience, the days, or an ad changed in Meta
run-deviation-warning: Once recorded, this round draws no conclusion on {{count}} groups: {{groups}}.
run-deviation-warning_one: Once recorded, this round draws no conclusion on {{groups}}.
run-deviation-warning-kept: The record stays and cannot be taken back.
run-schedule-start-fixed: The start date can no longer change: a report already counts.
run-schedule-start-fixed-ended: The start date can no longer change: the round ended early.
run-schedule-move-help: The day the ads actually went live. The last day moves with it; the number of days stays the same.
run-schedule-end-help: The last day the ads ran: on or after the start, no later than today, and before the planned last day.
run-schedule-end-warning: The result will take {{day}} as the round's last day and can be read once the orders after it have come in. With fewer days it may not be able to tell yet.
run-result-not-yet: The result can be read from {{day}}: after the round's last day, once its orders have come in.
run-result-due: The round is over and its orders have come in.
run-result-outdated: The reports, matches or days changed since you last looked.
run-result-free: Free. It reads the reports that count now.
run-result-scope: This result is about these ads only.
